arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

xls = pd.ExcelFile('budget.xlsx')
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)

for name in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(xls, sheet_name=name, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} | shape: {df.shape} ===")
    print(df.head(30).to_string())

import json
from openpyxl import load_workbook

wb = load_workbook("budget.xlsx", data_only=True)
ws = wb["Budget"]

# Expense rows: categories in col A, item names in col B, amounts in col C (rows 11-22)
cats, total = {}, 0
errors = []
for r in range(11, 23):
    cat = ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
    amt = ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value
    if amt is None or not isinstance(amt, (int, float)):
        errors.append(f"row {r}: non-numeric amount {amt!r}")
        continue
    cats[cat] = cats.get(cat, 0) + amt
    total += amt

print("PER_CATEGORY:", json.dumps(cats, sort_keys=True))
print("TOTAL_EXPENSES:", total)
print("ERRORS:", errors)
